ns2:section.sectionText: Herpetology Field Techniques will introduce students to techniques used in monitoring and research of reptiles and amphibians. It will cover methods for sampling, capturing, and marking herpetological populations and communities. This course will meet 11:00-3:00 on Saturdays (March 23-April 27) with an evening field trip on March 23 and a weekend field trip April 20-21. This course will charge a field trip fee.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Natural Res & Env Sci department.
